items.originalTitle: Cadillac reveals date for F1 engine factory debut, thanks drivers for being “patient”
items.summaryEn: Cadillac has announced that its Formula 1 engine factory in Charlotte, North Carolina, will open on 18 December. General Motors was approved by the FIA in 2025 as a power unit supplier from the 2029 season onwards.
detailZh: 凯迪拉克公布F1引擎工厂启用日期，感谢车手耐心等待
位于夏洛特的动力单元工厂将于圣诞节前启用
通用汽车总裁马克·罗伊斯在巴塞罗那展示凯迪拉克一次性试车用的F1涂装
凯迪拉克宣布其F1引擎工厂将于12月18日启用。
通用汽车于2025年获得国际汽联批准，将从2029赛季起成为动力单元供应商，因此在该制造商位于北卡罗来纳州夏洛特的基地建设了新的F1发动机设施。
“我们将在12月18日于北卡罗来纳州夏洛特全面启用我们的整个发动机工厂，”通用汽车总裁马克·罗伊斯在纽约举行的Autosport Business Exchange会议上宣布。“所以进展非常顺利。”
通用汽车现在还有几年时间来设计自己的动力单元，但时机可能并不理想——国际汽联主席穆罕默德·本·苏拉耶姆已承诺F1将在2031年前改回V8发动机——可能使用可持续燃料，并降低电力占比。在这种情况下，通用汽车的动力单元最多只能使用两个赛季，如果改换提前到2030年，则可能只有一个赛季。
与此同时，凯迪拉克正在使用客户版法拉利动力单元，而车队首个赛季迄今颇为艰难。它是2026年唯一尚未得分的车队，且MAC-26在最近四站排位赛中均为全场最慢。
“你知道，我们来这里不是为了垫底，所以我们必须坚持到底，打造这支车队，打造动力单元，打造赛车，就像我们在GTP中所做的那样，”罗伊斯说。“在这里需要更多时间，因为这是一个我们从未比赛过的地方。你必须找到合适的人、合适的工程师和合适的车手，我们必须真正启动这个进程，而且它是对数式的，不是线性的。”
老将塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯和瓦尔特利·博塔斯在这种情况下带来了宝贵的经验，但他们也录得了职业生涯最差的成绩。
“你不可能赢下每一场比赛——没有人能赢下每一场比赛——所以当这种情况发生时，当他们遇到不幸的一天，或者犯了错误时，他们会从那场比赛中走出来，完善自己的技艺——无论是赛车还是他们自己，或者他们的身体素质，或者无论那是什么——他们为那份完美而驾驶，”罗伊斯说。
“为我们参赛的这两位先生都做到了这一点，他们真正理解需要付出什么以及这个过程。说实话，我非常非常高兴他们对我们有耐心；那需要特别的人。”
detailEn: Cadillac reveals date for F1 engine factory debut, thanks drivers for being “patient”
Charlotte-based power unit plant set to open before Christmas
General Motors president Mark Reuss presents Cadillac's one-off shakedown F1 livery for Barcelona
Cadillac has revealed its Formula 1 engine factory will open on 18 December.

General Motors was approved by the FIA in 2025 as a power unit supplier from the 2029 season onwards, hence the construction of new F1 engine facilities at the manufacturer’s base in Charlotte, North Carolina.

“We're opening our whole engine factory, if you will, in Charlotte, North Carolina on 18 December,” General Motors president Mark Reuss announced in a conference at Autosport Business Exchange in New York. “So that's coming really well.”

General Motors now has another couple of years to design its own power unit, though the timing may be suboptimal – FIA president Mohammed Ben Sulayem has committed to F1 switching back to V8 engines – potentially running on sustainable fuel with a smaller share of electric power – by 2031. In that case, GM’s powertrain would get two seasons in action at best, potentially just one if the switch is brought forward to 2030.

In the meantime, Cadillac is running customer Ferrari power units, and the team’s maiden season has been tricky thus far. It is the only outfit yet to score a point in 2026, and the MAC-26 has qualified slowest of all at the last four rounds.

“You know, we’re not here to finish last, so we’ve got to follow through and build this team, build the powertrain and build the car, like we did in GTP,” Reuss said. “That takes a little more time here, because this is a place where we've never raced. You’ve got to get the right people with the right engineers and the right drivers, and we’ve got to get that process really going, and it's logarithmic, it's not linear.”
Veterans Sergio Perez and Valtteri Bottas have been bringing invaluable experience in that context, but they have also been recording their worst career results.

“You can't win every race – no one can win every race – so when it happens, when they have a day that is unfortunate, or mistakes were made, they move on from that race and perfect their craft – whether it's with the car or themselves, or their physicality, or whatever that is – and they drive for that perfection,” Reuss said.

“Both of these gentlemen in the race for us do that, and they really understand what it takes and the process. I'm very, very happy that they're patient with us, to be honest; that takes a special person.”

items.originalTitle: Audi hands F3 runner-up Freddie Slater F1 practice debut
detailZh: 奥迪将F3亚军弗雷迪·斯莱特推上F1练习赛首秀
该品牌的门生即将首次驾驶F1赛车
奥迪青训车队车手弗雷迪·斯莱特将在墨西哥城和圣保罗进行几场自由练习赛，首次在F1赛车的驾驶舱中亮相
事实上，在为德国品牌开启首个F1赛季之前，奥迪接管了索伯车队，同时启动了一个新的车手学院，这个学院在很大程度上依赖于斯莱特的努力
之前是意大利F4和欧洲区域公式区域冠军，斯莱特通过在公式3中取得第二名，在乌戈·乌戈楚克乌之后，实现了人们对他的期望——这位18岁的英国人是排名最高的新秀。
在晋升到公式2并与Invicta一起——跟随同是Trident F3赛车手的加布里埃尔·博托莱托、莱昂纳多·福尔纳罗利和拉斐尔·卡马拉的脚步——斯莱特将在墨西哥和巴西大奖赛的FP1中参赛，帮助奥迪满足年轻车手的规则要求。
今年早些时候，阿尔派青训车队的保罗·阿隆两次被借调到奥迪进行自由练习，而斯莱特将获得车队最后两次强制性的新秀出场机会，分别取代尼科·胡肯伯格和博托莱托一次。
“在大奖赛周末驾驶一辆公式1赛车对我来说是一个重要的时刻，这是我从小就梦寐以求的事情，”斯莱特说。“今年我学到了很多，与奥迪的这些自由练习将是我继续积累赛道经验的机会。”
“成为奥迪车手发展计划的一部分已经为我带来了许多难以置信的机会，我对他们的信任和支持表示感激。我非常期待能够上赛道：我的重点是尽我所能做好工作，帮助车队完成其计划，并从各节练习与排位中尽可能多地吸取经验。”
“我们看到了弗雷迪在近几年里在赛道内外都取得了巨大的进步；现在是弗雷迪晋升的时候了，”奥迪赛车总监和车手发展计划总监艾伦·麦克尼什认为。“在墨西哥和巴西的这些亮相将给他提供宝贵的F1周末赛事经验，并在他下赛季晋升到F2之前继续发展的另一个机会。我们期待着看到他在R26赛车上的表现，并支持他通过这两个重要的FP1练习。”
“早些时候，凯迪拉克测试和开发车手科尔顿·赫塔将在美国大奖赛上驾驶塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯的车。奥斯汀将标志着这位加利福尼亚人的今年第四个FP1练习，尽管他在蒙扎的最新一次练习因疑似液压问题而提前结束。”
“在COTA赛道前为美国观众驾驶MAC-26赛车将是一件特别的事情，”赫塔说。“我对这条赛道有着美好的回忆——2019年在这里赢得我的第一个IndyCar赛事是一个职业生涯中的重大时刻，所以在这条赛道上驾驶F1赛车感觉像是回到了起点。”
“我在巴塞罗那、布达佩斯和蒙扎的FP1比赛中与车队建立了良好的节奏，所以周五上午的目标很简单：干净利落地执行测试程序，帮助工程师收集有关设置的可靠数据，并将车交给Checo，给他一些有用的反馈，以支持车队在周末剩余的比赛。”
“一区的高速清扫段和一圈结束时的紧密、低速转弯对车辆设置来说很棘手，而颠簸总是增加了一个额外的维度，”车队负责人Marcin Budkowski对美洲赛车场表示。
“我们期待着Colton周五在FP1中重返赛车，我们还计划为评估带来一些小的地板和冷却升级。Colton从他的IndyCar生涯中非常了解这个赛道，因此他的反馈在我们为周末建立基准时将非常有价值。”
“目前F2排名低至第19位，Herta告诉Motorsport.com，他仍然希望在2028年进入F1，而他的下一年计划仍然不明朗。”
detailEn: Audi hands F3 runner-up Freddie Slater F1 practice debut
The brand’s protege is set to drive an F1 car for the first time
Audi junior Freddie Slater will make his debut at the wheel of a Formula 1 car with a couple of Free Practice 1 outings in Mexico City and Sao Paulo.
Audi took over the Sauber team ahead of the 2026 season for the German brand’s maiden F1 season, incidentally launching a new driver academy, which has largely rested on Slater’s shoulders.

Previously an Italian F4 and Formula Regional European champion, Slater has lived up to expectations by taking second place in Formula 3 behind Ugo Ugochukwu – the 18-year-old Briton was the highest-placed rookie in the standings.

Ahead of his step up to Formula 2 with Invicta – following in the footsteps of fellow Trident F3 racers Gabriel Bortoleto, Leonardo Fornaroli and Rafael Camara – Slater will be in action in FP1 at the Mexican and Brazilian grands prix, helping Audi fulfill the rules’ young-driver requirements.

Alpine junior Paul Aron was loaned to Audi on two occasions earlier this season for free practice sessions, and Slater is getting the team’s last two mandatory rookie outings, replacing Nico Hulkenberg and Bortoleto once each.

“Getting behind the wheel of a Formula 1 car at a grand prix weekend is a big moment for me and something I’ve been dreaming of since I was a kid,” Slater said. “I’ve learned a lot this year, and these free practice outings with Audi will be another opportunity to keep gaining on-track experience.

“Being part of the Audi Driver Development Programme has already given me some incredible opportunities, and I am grateful for their trust and support. I’m really looking forward to getting out on track: my focus will be on doing the best job I can, helping the team with its programme and taking as many learnings as possible from both sessions.”

“We have seen Freddie making great progress throughout recent years, both on and off the track; it is the right time for Freddie to step up,” Audi’s racing director and DDP director Allan McNish reckoned. “These appearances in Mexico and Brazil will give him valuable experience of a Formula 1 race weekend, and another chance to continue his development before he steps up to Formula 2 next season. We are looking forward to seeing him in the R26 and supporting him through these two important FP1 sessions.”

Earlier, Cadillac test and development driver Colton Herta will be in action at the United States Grand Prix, driving Sergio Perez’s car. Austin will mark the Californian’s fourth FP1 session of the year, though his latest, in Monza, was cut short by a suspected hydraulic issue.

“Driving the MAC-26 in front of the American fans at COTA is going to be special,” Herta said. “I have great memories at this track – winning my first IndyCar race here back in 2019 was a huge moment in my career, so stepping into an F1 car on this layout feels like coming full circle.

“I’ve built up a good rhythm with the team through my previous FP1 runs in Barcelona, Budapest, and Monza, so my goal for Friday morning is straightforward: execute the test program cleanly, help the engineers gather good data on the set-up, and hand the car back to Checo with some useful feedback to support the team for the rest of the weekend.”

“The high-speed sweeping section in sector one and the tight, low-speed turns at the end of the lap are a tricky for car set-up, and the bumps always add an extra dimension,” team principal Marcin Budkowski said of the Circuit of The Americas.

“We are looking forward to having Colton back in the car for FP1 on Friday, and we also plan to bring some small floor and cooling upgrades for evaluation. Colton knows this circuit very well from his IndyCar career, so his feedback will be valuable as we establish our baseline for the weekend.”
Currently a lowly 19th in the F2 standings, Herta told Motorsport.com he was still aiming at F1 by 2028, while his plans for next year remain unclear.

items.originalTitle: Adobe makes first move into F1 with Alpine deal
items.summaryEn: Adobe has entered its first-ever Formula 1 commercial partnership by teaming up with Alpine as its official AI fan experience partner, with major activations set to begin at the start of the 2027 season.
detailZh: Adobe首次进入F1商业合作领域，与阿尔派达成了一项围绕其AI产品的新协议。
这家美国软件巨头旗下产品包括Firefly、InDesign、Premiere Pro、Acrobat和Photoshop，它已成为阿尔派的“官方AI车迷体验合作伙伴”，重大活动将于2027年F1赛季初启动。
有关这一新合作的更多细节将于周四晚在奥斯汀公布，这是美国大奖赛前举行的Axios x The Race F1 Premium Playbook商务交流活动的一部分。
阿尔派全球营销总监Guy Martin、车手皮埃尔·加斯利、Adobe全球企业营销副总裁Marissa Dacay以及Liberty Media总裁兼首席执行官Derek Chang是活动演讲嘉宾。
这项以车迷为核心的合作围绕Adobe的人工智能解决方案展开，这些方案利用人工智能代理和大语言模型（LLM），并承诺为车迷提供“人工智能驱动的设计工具”，其思路类似于Adobe与英格兰超级联赛的车迷互动合作——例如车迷可以为自己的梦幻英超球队创建人工智能生成的队徽——以及与NFL和MLB的合作。
达凯表示：“一级方程式赛车早已超越了赛道上发生的事情，成为一项全球性的体育现象，在这里卓越的工程技术、创新、可持续性和文化联结交汇融合。”
“我们与BWT 阿尔派一级方程式车队的合作展示了Adobe的人工智能技术如何推动新方式，在全球范围内提升车迷互动，创造更多个性化联结，并为车迷提供分享对这项运动热情的不同途径。”
该合作为阿尔派一级方程式车队提供Adobe CX Enterprise，Adobe称其为一套将营销、创意和人工智能技术结合在一起的产品，“以打造有影响力的车迷体验”。
Adobe 表示，超过 20,000 个品牌使用其产品来推动客户体验编排，企业可以借此预判客户需求并定制互动方式。
阿尔派 还将使用 Adobe Experience 平台实时了解车迷互动情况，“让车队能够在关键时刻通过合适的渠道传递合适的信息”。
马丁补充说，车队正“进入一个令人无比兴奋的新时代”，并表示“创意和个性化将成为我们表达雄心、身份认同以及与全球受众和车迷建立联系的核心”。
“Adobe 是这段旅程中了不起的合作伙伴，为我们提供了以全新和意想不到的方式将愿景变为现实的工具。我们有机会共同创造远远超越赛道的体验。”
detailEn: Adobe has made its first ever move into a Formula 1 commercial partnership by joining Alpine in a new deal focused around its AI products.

The American software giant, whose products include Firefly, InDesign, Premiere Pro, Acrobat and Photoshop, has become “the official AI fan experience partner” for Alpine with major activations set to begin at the start of the 2027 F1 season.

More details of the new tie-up will be announced on Thursday evening in Austin as part of the Axios x The Race Formula 1 Premium Playbook business networking event that takes place ahead of the United States Grand Prix.

Alpine global marketing director Guy Martin, driver Pierre Gasly, Adobe's global vice president of enterprise marketing Marissa Dacay, and Liberty Media president and CEO Derek Chang are among the speakers at the event.

The fan-focused partnership revolves around Adobe's AI solutions that utilise AI agents and large language models (LLMs), with fans promised “AI-powered design tools” in a similar vein to Adobe’s fan engagement deals with the English Premier League - where fans can create AI-generated emblems for their Fantasy Premier League teams, for example - as well as the NFL and MLB.

Dacay said: “Formula 1 has become so much more than what happens on the track, becoming a global sports phenomenon where engineering excellence, innovation, sustainability and cultural connection meet.

“Our partnership with BWT Alpine Formula 1 team showcases how Adobe's AI technology is powering new ways to drive fan engagement around the world, creating more personalised connections and providing fans different ways to share their passion for the sport.”

The partnership provides the Alpine F1 team with Adobe CX Enterprise, which Adobe calls a set of products that bring marketing, creativity and AI technologies together “to drive impactful fan experiences”.
Adobe says more than 20,000 brands use its products to drive customer experience orchestration, where businesses can anticipate customer demands and tailor engagement.
Alpine will also use the Adobe Experience platform for a real-time view into fan engagement “where the team can deliver the right message on the right channel, in moments that matter”.

Martin added that the team was “entering an incredibly exciting new era”, and said “creativity and personalisation will be at the heart of how we express our ambitions, our identity, and our connection with audiences and fans worldwide”.

“Adobe is an incredible partner for this journey, giving us the tools to bring our vision to life in new and unexpected ways. Together we have an opportunity to create experiences that extend far beyond the racetrack.”
keyPointsZh: 合作细节将于周四晚在奥斯汀举行的Axios x The Race F1 Premium Playbook商务交流活动上公布，该活动在美国大奖赛前举行。
合作围绕Adobe的AI解决方案展开，涉及AI智能体和大语言模型，车迷将获得“AI驱动的设计工具”。
Adobe此前已与英超、NFL和MLB有类似的球迷互动合作，例如球迷可为梦幻英超球队生成AI徽章。
keyPointsEn: Further details of the partnership will be announced on Thursday evening in Austin at the Axios x The Race Formula 1 Premium Playbook business networking event held ahead of the United States Grand Prix.
The partnership centers on Adobe's AI solutions using AI agents and large language models, with fans promised AI-powered design tools.
Adobe has similar fan engagement deals with the Premier League, NFL and MLB, such as letting fans create AI-generated emblems for Fantasy Premier League teams.
